description: Bicycle and Pedestrian Counts in Colorado is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Location and counts for number of pedestrians and bicyclists to pass by a specific spot in a given hour over a 24 hour period, from the Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT). Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are ped, bic, bicycle, bicyclists, bike. The table has 41 columns. Attribution on the portal: CDOT. The portal shows 2016-03-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
